facts.text: Use pnpm, not npm, for every JavaScript project in the workspace.
The editor is helix; use hx in terminal sessions.
Deploy to staging with make deploy-staging once the integration tests pass.
Production deploys need a second reviewer and a signed release tag.
The application database is PostgreSQL 16 running in a container.
The API listens on port 8080 locally and is proxied under /api in the browser.
Go projects pin the toolchain in go.mod and build with CGO disabled.
Run golangci-lint with the build tags nobadger,nomysql,nopgx before pushing.
Pull requests need one approving review before they merge into main.
The weekly planning meeting is on Mondays at ten in the morning.
Database backups run nightly at 02:00 and are kept for fourteen days.
Secrets live in the OS keychain and never in environment files committed to git.
Application logs are structured JSON lines written to stderr.
Dark mode is the default theme in every web interface.
Timestamps in the API are UTC and the UI shows them in the user's local zone.
CI runs go vet and go test on Linux, macOS and Windows.
Commit messages are one line in the imperative mood.
Feature branches are named with a short kebab-case topic such as fix-login-redirect.
Clear the Go build cache with go clean -cache when the disk is nearly full.
Local containers attach to the bridge network named studio-net.
The guest VM accepts SSH keys only, never password logins.
HTTP clients retry idempotent requests three times with exponential backoff.
The public API allows 100 requests per minute per token.
The on-call rotation changes hands every Tuesday at noon.
Invoices are exported as PDF through the reporting service.
Full text search uses SQLite FTS5 with the porter stemmer.
Releases are tagged vX.Y.Z and the changelog changes in the same commit.

pages.compiled: The billing service invoices customers monthly, exports PDF invoices, and reconciles payments from the payment provider every night.

pages.title: Onboarding checklist
pages.compiled: New engineers get repository access, install the toolchain with make setup, and pair with a teammate for their first week.

pages.title: Ana

pages.title: Incident response
pages.compiled: During an incident, page the on-call engineer, open a shared channel, and write a timeline in the postmortem template.
